title: 彭博有限合伙企业：美国职位空缺回升，消费者信心却下滑
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What do you say? Well, we're seeing Americans a little more disappointed in the way the economy is going than we anticipated, and we're also seeing better than expected Joltz job openings.
segments.zh: 我们看到美国人对经济走向的失望程度高于预期，同时职位空缺数据也好于预期。

segments.en: They're down from what they were in the month of, down from what they were in the month of May.
These are the latest numbers, 7,594,000 down from 7,618,000 in April.
segments.zh: 最新数据为759.4万，低于4月的761.8万。

segments.en: The quits rate is 1.9% that is unchanged, so some strength in the jobs numbers.
segments.zh: 离职率为1.9%，保持不变，就业数据显现一定韧性。

segments.en: Now we've got the revision to the Joltz number, and we've actually gone up a little bit, 7,594,000, as I said, and the revised April number is 7,585,000, so up by a few there's
segments.zh: 职位空缺数据上修，最新为759.4万，4月修正值为758.5万，显示职位空缺比之前认为的要多。

segments.en: more job openings out there than thought. Now in terms of consumer confidence, 91.2, that is down from 93.1 as an initial estimate,
segments.zh: 消费者信心指数为91.2，低于初值93.1。

segments.en: but 90.6 is the revised, so it's up a little bit, but both numbers are not very strong for consumer confidence.
segments.zh: 修正值为90.6，略有上升，但两个数值均显示消费者信心不强。

segments.en: The present situation, 114, from 121.2, and the expectations index is unchanged at 74.4,
segments.zh: 现状指数从121.2降至114，预期指数持平于74.4。

segments.en: so at this point what we've got is consumers still reacting to the gasoline prices I would
segments.zh: 目前来看，消费者仍在应对汽油价格的影响，尽管当月价格有所下降。

segments.en: imagine, even though they came down during the month and people thought that might lead to something.
segments.zh: 人们原本以为价格下降会带来一些变化。
